additionalInspected.caption: ​安平古堡，原稱熱蘭遮城、安平城或臺灣城，是一座位於臺灣臺南市安平區的一個城郭遺址。於1624年由荷蘭東印度公司建立，是臺灣最早的要塞建築。自建城以來，曾是荷蘭人統治臺灣的中樞，也曾是鄭氏王朝統治者的住處。
additionalInspected.inspection: 2022 remnant original inspected: irregular plaster loss/brickwork, roots and gaps, nonuniform broken top; curb/planting not a building wall-height datum.

primarySources.inspection: Tainan operator distinguishes surviving old southern wall from later rebuilt site;1975 renovation added pointed roof and white exterior to the tower. Current exterior is not the complete Dutch fortress.

Owner history:1897 portions leveled and three brick platforms built;1930 residence adapted to exhibition/reception hall;1935 excavations near southwest bastion;1975 pointed-roof white tower finish. Historical fort dimensions do not specify the current ruins or current tower.

2024 heritage authority states red-topped lookout originates in1944, with red pointed roof added1975. It identifies surviving north/south walls, southwest bastion archaeology and west drainage. Current site combines different periods; do not reconstruct absent Dutch enclosure from artwork.

Actual primary text identifies outer southern wall relicNo11 as approximately65.8m east/west, with failing brick/mortar, deformed opening, vegetation and cracks. This is not a precise modern wall-axis bearing or height.

officialAerial.inspection: Actually inspected both complete12-tile mosaic and native-index overlay. Watermark readsNLSC2023; precise acquisition epoch is not otherwise specified. Current later inner platform and hall align broadly with native outlines. Red tower roof is visibly west of rounded map feature, so photo parallax/ground-position and rounded-feature identity require reconciliation before an exact placement claim. Surviving long remnant runs west/northwest outside raised platform, distinct from later brick terraces. No raster pixels embedded in assets.

scope: Surviving historic walls and current Anping Fort platform/watchtower; do not invent the vanished complete Dutch fortress.
limitations: Native broad site/terrace root height5 must not be uniformly extruded into a complete fortress. Native inner platform is a cap outline, not a roof or surveyed batter toe.

Rounded native layer2 feature is not the photographed square shaft/cabin plan; exact identity/extent still requires reconciliation. Surviving wall line is absent from the rendered standard tile layers and remains pending owner-plan/geographic controls.
No precise measured current tower height, platform step levels or individual bay dimensions have been verified. Historical fort dimensions cannot set present silhouette.
Independent ground must be frozen before geometry. Review output spacing is not survey accuracy; no fitting/flattening or universal host-terrain claim.
